metadata.title: How To Find family members of a deceased person!
metadata.author: Surplus Institute / David Church / Unclaimed Funds
metadata.shortDescription:
How to find family members of a deceased person is one of the biggest challenges in probate, surplus funds, and unclaimed money cases. In this video, I share 6 proven ways to locate heirs and next of kin so you can move cases forward and close deals.

Join our great community: skool.com/surplusinstitute 

Whether you’re working probate cases, surplus funds, mortgage overages, or unclaimed property, knowing how to find family members of a deceased owner is critical if you want to close deals and help families recover money that’s rightfully theirs.

In this 6-minute training, you’ll learn:

How to find next of kin when the owner is deceased

Where to search for family members and heirs

How to use public records, probate filings, and obituaries

What to do when there is no will or obvious relatives

How professionals locate heirs legally and ethically

Common mistakes that cause people to miss family members

This is the exact process I use in real surplus and probate cases, and it works whether you’re brand new or already closing deals.

If you’re serious about building a business around surplus funds, probate leads, or unclaimed money, this is foundational knowledge you can’t skip.

👉 Subscribe for more real-world training on surplus funds, probate, and unclaimed property
👉 Comment “HEIRS” if you want my resources or tools for finding family members
👉 Share this video with anyone working probate or estate cases
